# Cashify

> Cashify is India's leading platform for buying and selling used mobile phones and gadgets with instant quotes, doorstep service, and comprehensive device repair solutions.

Cashify operates a dual-service model combining a B2B marketplace (SuperSale) for refurbished smartphones alongside consumer-facing services for buying/selling used devices and professional doorstep repair across multiple device brands and repair categories.

## Key Topics

- Doorstep Repair Service
- Mobile Phone Repair
- Used Phone Trading
- Battery Replacement
- Screen Repair
- Motherboard Repair
- Charging Jack Repair
- Camera Repair
- Microphone Repair
- Proximity Sensor Repair
- Device Replacement
- Instant Quotes
- Money-Back Guarantee
- Same-Day Service
- Refurbished Smartphones

## Core Platform

- [Cashify Homepage - Sell/Buy Old and Used Mobile Phones Online](https://www.cashify.in): Cashify homepage: buy/sell used phones, gadgets, instant quotes, doorstep service
- [SuperSale B2B Marketplace](https://supersale.cashify.in/lp/home/index.html): SuperSale B2B marketplace landing page for refurbished smartphones in India
